name: async-vdot
title: Async VDOT — Video Directly Observed Therapy
shortDescription: Provider dashboard for async medication adherence via patient video recordings.
description:
Async VDOT brings Video Directly Observed Therapy into your doxy.me session. Designed for medication adherence programs, VDOT lets patients record themselves taking medications which providers review asynchronously — eliminating the need for live observation sessions.

Key Features:
• Dashboard with pending reviews, active patients, and adherence stats
• Review Queue for approving or flagging patient video recordings
• Patients list with enrollment management
• Copy patient link button for easy onboarding
• Auto sign-in when opened inside doxy.me via embedded handshake
• Designed for TB, HIV, and chronic disease medication programs

Demo Accounts:
• drswensson — Dr. Swensson provider view
• drturner — Dr. Turner provider view

Built by doxy.me Labs. Integrated natively with doxy.me telehealth platform.
optionalDescription: Ideal for public health providers, infectious disease clinicians, and care coordinators managing patients on observed therapy protocols. Reduces administrative burden while maintaining clinical oversight.
